video.title: Learn the most Important DevOps tools | Top 5 Devops tools 2023 #devops #cloudengineer #devopstools

transcript.text: top 5 devops tools you should learn
number one is Docker Docker is a
containerization platform every company
is using Docker to deploy their
applications on containers second devops
tool to learn is kubernetes kubernetes
is container orchestration tool used to
manage multiple containers of your
application it has features like Auto
scaling load balancing persistent
storage and a lot of other features it
is also one of the most popular tools
right now in the market number three we
have terraform so terraform is a
multi-cloud infrastructure as code tool
used to automate the provisioning of
infrastructure on AWS Azure gcp
kubernetes a long list of providers and
if you want to learn you can check out
my videos on dev number four is gitlab
so gitlab is one of the important devops
tool you should learn earlier we were
using gitlab repositories just to store
our code but now gitlab has a lot of
features like integrated CI CD security
monitoring so you should learn gitlab
number five is Linux I know it's not a
devops tool but it's very important for
you to learn Linux because all the tools
that we have discussed can be run using
per commands so it's very important for
you to learn Linux so these are the five
important tools you should learn if you
want to become a devops engineer
